desktop_entries.text:
[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Version=1.0
Name=accessiweather
Comment=Start AccessiWeather at login
Exec="/opt/accessiweather/accessiweather"
X-GNOME-Autostart-enabled=true

[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Version=1.0
Name=aw
Comment=Start AccessiWeather at login
Exec="/home/me/My \"Apps\"/aw/accessiweather"
X-GNOME-Autostart-enabled=true

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
	<key>KeepAlive</key>
	<false/>
	<key>Label</key>
	<string>net.orinks.accessiweather.startup</string>
	<key>ProgramArguments</key>
	<array>
		<string>/Applications/AccessiWeather.app/Contents/MacOS/AccessiWeather</string>
	</array>
	<key>RunAtLoad</key>
	<true/>
	<key>WorkingDirectory</key>
	<string>/Applications/AccessiWeather.app/Contents/MacOS</string>
</dict>
</plist>
